source: Sanitized projection of the private CAH rerun record. Private task-state, account, conversation, host-path and raw-log fields are omitted.

terminal_disposition.note: The user explicitly stopped further Phase-2B work after the G32 physical Worker attempt stalled without a durable semantic result. Native direct-preview acceptance is not claimed.

semantic_pixel_qa.note: The intended retro camera was clearly readable in native Lit captures. No severe missing-shader, checkerboard, placeholder, all-black, exploded, clipped or missing-geometry defect was accepted.
semantic_pixel_qa.limitation: The viewport background remained visibly black. Phase 1 was accepted because the model itself was readable and the low/bottom inspection path was floor-free.

accepted_findings.same_path_collision: The default combined provider selected a base-game PatchPak candidate at an equal read order; successful logical-path export alone did not prove MOD provenance.

phase2a.conclusion: Phase 2A accepted package/dependency reconnaissance and established that later Viewer work must intentionally select the MOD member rather than trust default equal-order provider behavior.

g20_timing.interpretation: The external job continued independently after the Worker had durably handed off.

historical_native_screenshots.note: The public README references previously published native Viewer screenshots from the preserved pre-clean public commit. The four 2026-09-28 Phase-1 rerun captures are represented here by exact byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

claims_not_made: publication of the UE-linked Viewer module
